fusions.name: Phantom Volley
fusions.desc: Looses 4 illusory bolts at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 arcane damage with a 15% chance to turn the target against its allies for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Borrowed Spell
fusions.desc: Fires a bolt that deals 30 arcane damage to the first enemy it meets and ignores its resistances. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Pilfered Mana
fusions.desc: Restores 4 mana a second for 6 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Sleight of Spell
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.
